contract_enforcement.scope: Declared literal and word-limit requirements only; all other findings remain advisory.

duplicate_paragraphs.comparison: literal text, including whitespace and line wrapping

internal_markdown_anchors.scope: simple inline fragment links and plain ASCII ATX headings

protected_literals.counting: case-sensitive, non-overlapping, entire raw decoded artifact

conformance.scope: Only the explicit patterns, word limits and literal requirements listed in this report.
conformance.statement: An evaluated check is not a pass, approval, or full conformance judgment.

limitations: No factual, semantic, tone, style, authorship, or AI-style assessment.

Prose blocks are blank-line-delimited nonheading text. Exact comparison preserves whitespace and wrapping; list/blockquote text can be included. Indented code and full Markdown grammar are not parsed.
Fenced code is masked with spaces while retaining newlines and offsets. Marker, anchor-link, and numeric scans also mask matched inline backticks.
Only [[TBD]], [[TODO]], [TBD], and [TODO] are markers. An immediately quote-wrapped marker is excluded; other quotation contexts are not inferred.

Anchors cover simple inline fragment links and plain ASCII ATX headings. Slugs lowercase, remove punctuation except hyphen/underscore, collapse spaces/tabs to hyphens, and suffix collisions -1, -2, etc. No renderer guarantee, reference-link, Setext, HTML, or custom-anchor support.
Numeric comparisons count lexical tokens, not numeric equivalence or meaning. Locations list all occurrences of changed tokens, not semantic alignments.
Word limits count raw whitespace-separated tokens, including markup/code. A passing limit does not establish preserved meaning or suitable length.
Contract literals use exact non-overlapping counts in the entire raw UTF-8 decoded artifact, including fenced code and quoted text.
